This article analyzes the exclusion reasons for [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] across Denmark and its five administrative regions. Because the available data consists of a single snapshot from 2025, no longitudinal trends can be established; the analysis instead focuses on the distribution and outliers within this specific reporting period.

The data reveals that the overwhelming majority of patient exclusions from the indicator calculation occur because the patient was not operated on ("Patienten er ikke opereret"). Nationally, this accounts for 6,643 exclusions, making it the clear leader among all exclusion criteria [^src1]. Among the individual regions, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] records the highest number of these exclusions (1,613), closely followed by [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] (1,579) and [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] (1,437) [^src1].

In stark contrast, the least common reason for exclusion nationally is an invalid CPR number ("Ugyldigt CPRnummer"), which accounts for only 78 cases across the entire country [^src1]. [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] is the trailer in this category, with just 8 exclusions [^src1]. 

A notable outlier in the regional distribution is [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], which reports only 9 exclusions for patients under 18 years of age ("Patienten er under 18 år") [^src1]. This is significantly lower than [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] (66) and [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] (54) [^src1]. Furthermore, the volume of non-operated patient exclusions (6,643) vastly overshadows the next highest category, "Operationen er ikke den første operation i hospitalsopholdet" (The operation is not the first operation in the hospital stay), which only accounts for 544 national exclusions [^src1].

## Table: AKDB_2025.pdf, p. 20

Rows compare: exclusion reason · Columns show: count per region

| Årsag | Danmark | Hovedstaden | Sjælland | Syddanmark | Midtjylland | Nordjylland |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ugyldigt CPRnummer. | 78 | 30 | 10 | 19 | 11 | 8 |
| Patienten er under 18 år. | 176 | 66 | 9 | 54 | 36 | 11 |
| Patienten er ikke opereret. | 6.643 | 1.613 | 1.023 | 1.437 | 1.579 | 991 |
| Operationen er ikke den første operation i hospitalsopholdet. | 544 | 182 | 76 | 144 | 113 | 29 |

Entities: indikator-3, region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-syddanmark, region-midtjylland, region-nordjylland

Summary: Tabellen dokumenterer antallet af patienter ekskluderet fra Indikator 3-beregningen pr. årsag og region, hvor 'Patienten er ikke opereret' er den dominerende eksklusionsgrund med over 6.600 tilfælde nationalt.
